effects: The signer sends exactly `assets` of USDT0 (0x779Ded…3736, the vault's immutable asset) to the vault via safeTransferFrom.
`onBehalf` receives newly minted hyperUSDTc shares; the number is previewDeposit(assets), set by the share price in storage after fees accrue.
The vault spends the signer's USDT0 allowance to the vault by `assets`.
formats.shown: Deposit 0.1 USDT0 for the onBehalf address, with a constant 'Share ticker: hyperUSDTc' field and 'Send shares to' naming the share recipient.

findings.title: deposit does not show how many shares are minted; the vault's share price in storage decides it.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.sol deposit: `accrueInterest(); uint256 shares = previewDeposit(assets); enter(assets, shares, onBehalf);`. The descriptor shows only `assets` and `onBehalf`. Calldata has no minimum-shares parameter.

findings.title: deposit shows a constant 'Share ticker' field with no amount, and labels the amount 'Deposit asset'.
findings.evidence: descriptor deposit fields: {"label":"Share ticker","format":"raw","value":"$.metadata.constants.vaultTicker"} and {"path":"assets","label":"Deposit asset"}. Case 0 screen: 'Share ticker: hyperUSDTc'.
findings.fix: Rename 'Deposit asset' to 'Deposit amount'. Fold the ticker into the intent, e.g. "Deposit {#.assets} into hyperUSDTc for {#.onBehalf}".

formats.key: withdraw(uint256 assets, address receiver, address onBehalf)
effects: `receiver` receives exactly `assets` of USDT0 from the vault.
The vault burns previewWithdraw(assets) hyperUSDTc shares, rounded up, from `onBehalf`. The share price in storage sets the number.
If the signer is not `onBehalf`, the burned shares come out of onBehalf's share allowance to the signer, unless that allowance is unlimited.
formats.shown: Withdraw exactly 1 USDT0 to the receiver, with the Owner (onBehalf) whose shares are burned shown as a field.

findings.title: withdraw does not show how many shares it burns from Owner; the share price in storage decides it.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.sol withdraw: `uint256 shares = previewWithdraw(assets); exit(assets, shares, receiver, onBehalf);` and exit: `deleteShares(onBehalf, shares);`. Calldata has no maximum-shares parameter.

formats.key: redeem(uint256 shares, address receiver, address onBehalf)
effects: The vault burns exactly `shares` hyperUSDTc from `onBehalf`.
`receiver` receives previewRedeem(shares) USDT0, rounded down. The share price in storage sets the amount.
If the signer is not `onBehalf`, onBehalf's share allowance to the signer goes down by `shares`, unless it is unlimited.
formats.shown: Redeem 49.98 hyperUSDTc to the receiver, with the Owner whose shares are burned. Nothing on the screen says which asset arrives.

findings.title: redeem never names USDT0 as the asset the receiver gets; only the burned shares appear.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.sol exit: `SafeERC20Lib.safeTransfer(asset, receiver, assets);` (asset = 0x779Ded…3736 USDT0). descriptor redeem interpolatedIntent "Redeem {#.shares} to {#.receiver}". Its fields show only shares, To and Owner. Case 2 screen: 'Redeem 49.976928666646728254 hyperUSDTc to 0x1745…'.
findings.fix: Change interpolatedIntent to "Redeem {#.shares} for USDT0 to {#.receiver}" or add a field that shows `$.metadata.constants.underlyingTicker` labelled 'Receive asset'.

findings.title: redeem does not show how much USDT0 is received; the share price in storage decides it, with no minimum.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.sol redeem: `uint256 assets = previewRedeem(shares); exit(assets, shares, receiver, onBehalf);`. Calldata has no minimum-assets parameter.
